◆Additional ability if attached to 〈Moona Hoshinova〉

[1/Turn] When the holomem this mascot is attached to deals special damage to your opponent's holomem, you may send 1 blue cheer from your archive to your back holomem.

Only 1 mascot can be attached to each of your holomem.

cards.name: えびふらいおん
cards.abilityText:
The holomem this mascot is attached to gets +20 HP.

◆Additional ability if attached to 〈Natsuiro Matsuri〉

During your opponent's turn, if the holomem this mascot is attached to is downed, you may reattach 1 yellow cheer from this holomem to your other 〈Natsuiro Matsuri〉.

Only 1 mascot can be attached to each of your holomem.

cards.name: まつりす
cards.abilityText:
If your [Oshi holomem or holomem with #Gen 1]'s ability rolled a die, you may archive this fan: Regard that resulting face number of the die as 4 instead.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Natsuiro Matsuri〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.

cards.name: スバ友
cards.abilityText:
During your opponent's turn, if the holomem this fan is attached to is downed, you may send the top card of your cheer deck to your 〈Oozora Subaru〉.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Oozora Subaru〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
